name: Global multiplicity sensitivity audit for exact paired tests

global_family.definition: All unique exact two-sided McNemar contrasts reported in the manuscript or associated Revision-11 results, with duplicated SVM tuning contrasts counted once.

procedures.holm: Step-down adjustment controlling the family-wise error rate over all 19 tests.
procedures.benjamini_hochberg: Step-up adjustment controlling the false discovery rate over all 19 tests.

confidence_interval_policy: Wilson and bootstrap intervals are marginal effect-size uncertainty summaries. They are not claimed to provide simultaneous 95% coverage across the full collection of outcomes.
interpretation_limits: The global family was assembled after peer-review feedback and was not preregistered.
The adjustment is a sensitivity audit and does not convert exploratory or post-selection comparisons into confirmatory tests.
Holm is treated as the conservative primary correction; Benjamini-Hochberg is a supporting FDR analysis.
Statistical significance is interpreted together with absolute effect size and the corpus-label estimand.
